notes: Cosmological bounds on thermally-produced axion-like particles from Planck 2018 + BAO. The paper constrains both axion-photon (g_agamma) and axion-gluon (Cg/fa, gd) couplings. AxionPhoton chosen per Fig. 7. Marginalized 95% CL bound g_agamma < 3.16e-8 GeV^-1 (Planck+BAO). Mass-dependent per-fixed-mass values (masses {1e-4...100} eV) are shown in Fig. 7 as diamonds but exact numerical values are not all tabulated in text; data_points are approximate reconstructions of the described curve shape (bound tightens toward ma~10 eV, rises around ma~30 eV, tightens again ~100 eV). Anchors from text: g_agamma<3.16e-8 marginalized, and 2.19e-8 at 1e-4 eV when ACT added (not used here). This is not a haloscope so no DM density assumed.
